issue_title: [BUG] Console.save_text clears recorded output when file write fails
problem_statement: In Console.save_text (as well as save_html and save_svg), if writing to the specified file fails (e.g. PermissionError, FileNotFoundError, or OSError/IOError), the recorded output in self._record_buffer is already cleared by the export_* call because clear=True is passed before the file write occurs. As a result, the recorded output is permanently lost and cannot be retried. The buffer should only be cleared after the file is successfully written.
system_instruction: You are a core maintainer of Textualize/rich. Fix open issue #4208. All necessary file content and test logs are provided above. Do not invoke any further tools. Output ONLY the git unified diff patch (diff --git a/rich/console.py b/rich/console.py) and a pytest test function.

messages.content: Fix issue #4208 in Textualize/rich: Console.save_text, save_html, and save_svg prematurely clear self._record_buffer before writing the file. If write fails with an OSError, the buffer is lost. Modify save_text, save_html, and save_svg to pass clear=False to export_*, and only clear self._record_buffer if the file write succeeds. Do not call any tools. Provide the unified diff patch.

def export_text(
        self,
        *,
        clear: bool = True,
        styles: bool = False,
    ) -> str:
        """Generate text from console contents."""
        with self._record_buffer_lock:
            text = "".join(
                segment.text
                for segment in self._record_buffer
                if not segment.control
            )
            if clear:
                self._record_buffer.clear()
        return text

    def save_text(
        self,
        path: str,
        *,
        clear: bool = True,
        styles: bool = False,
        encoding: str = "utf-8",
    ) -> None:
        """Save plain text of recorded output to a file."""
        text = self.export_text(clear=clear, styles=styles)
        with open(path, "w", encoding=encoding) as write_file:
            write_file.write(text)

    def save_html(
        self,
        path: str,
        *,
        clear: bool = True,
        theme: Optional[TerminalTheme] = None,
        encoding: str = "utf-8",
        inline_styles: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        """Save HTML of recorded output to a file."""
        html = self.export_html(
            clear=clear, theme=theme, inline_styles=inline_styles
        )
        with open(path, "w", encoding=encoding) as write_file:
            write_file.write(html)

    def save_svg(
        self,
        path: str,
        *,
        title: str = "Rich",
        theme: Optional[TerminalTheme] = None,
        clear: bool = True,
        code_format: str = FORMAT_SVG,
        font_aspect_ratio: float = 0.61,
        unique_id: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Save SVG of recorded output to a file."""
        svg = self.export_svg(
            title=title,
            theme=theme,
            clear=clear,
            code_format=code_format,
            font_aspect_ratio=font_aspect_ratio,
            unique_id=unique_id,
        )
        with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as write_file:
            write_file.write(svg)
